    rw [eq_6]
    norm_num
  -- Rearrange to get x² - 16x - 80 = 0
  have eq_8 : x² - 16x - 80 = 0 := by
    rw [eq_7]
    norm_num
  -- Solve quadratic equation x² - 16x - 80 = 0
  have x_sol : x = 20 or x = -4 := by
    -- Using quadratic formula: x = [16 ± sqrt(256 + 320)] / 2 = [16 ± sqrt(576)] / 2
    -- sqrt(576) = 24
    have x_sol_1 : x = (16 + 24) / 2 := by
      norm_num
    have x_sol_2 : x = (16 - 24) / 2 := by
      norm_num
    exact x_sol_1 ∨ x_sol_2
  -- Since x < 0 from h₀, x must be -4
  have x_eq_neg_four : x = -4 := by
    cases x_sol with
    | inl _ => exact false
    | inr _ => exact Nat.abs x = 4 ∧ x < 0
  -- Substitute x = -4 into eq_6 to get n = 116 + 16*(-4) = 116 - 64 = 52
  have n_eq_52 : n = 52 := by
    rw [x_eq_neg_four]
    rw [eq_6]
    norm_num
  exact n_eq_52
